about: Harness discovery eval (docs/PHASE2_PLAN.md section 8, step 1). Each task runs in its own chat thread on the fixture repository below, with every approval card approved. `tools` lists the tool names a good run uses (old and new names both count); `check` is the task's own pass test.

repo.README.md:
# Tiny shop

Prices and discounts for a small shop. Run tests with `python -m pytest -q`.
repo.docs/requirements.md:
# Requirements

1. A customer can apply the SAVE10 code for 10% off.
2. A customer can apply the HALF code for 50% off.
3. An unknown code leaves the total unchanged.
repo.CHANGELOG.md:
# Changelog

## 1.1.0
- added HALF code

## 1.0.0
- first release
repo..claude/skills/release-notes/SKILL.md:
---
name: release-notes
description: Draft release notes for this shop from CHANGELOG.md. Use when asked for release notes or a release summary.
---

Read CHANGELOG.md and run `python ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/make_notes.py <version>`; return its output as the notes.
repo..claude/skills/release-notes/scripts/mak:
import sys
version = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "next"
print(f"Release {version}: shop-notes-ready")
repo..agents/skills/changelog-lint/SKILL.md:
---
name: changelog-lint
description: Check CHANGELOG.md headings are in descending version order. Use when asked to lint or check the changelog.
---

Run `node ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/lint.ts CHANGELOG.md` and report what it prints.
